apps.name: MirrorDrive
apps.tagline: Two-way folder sync between your phone and Google Drive, on your schedule.
apps.about: MirrorDrive pairs a folder on your phone with a folder on Google Drive and keeps them in sync -- two-way, upload-only, or download-only, your choice per mapping. Sync runs on a schedule in the background (interval or a fixed daily time, with Wi-Fi-only and charging-only options) or on demand, with a per-mapping file browser, categorized sync history, and a Duplicate files screen that finds byte-identical copies across all your mappings so you can review and clean them up. Built-in audio and video playback for anything synced. Uses Google's restricted drive.file scope -- MirrorDrive only ever sees files and folders it created or that you explicitly picked, never your whole Drive.

apps.name: TwinClean
apps.tagline: Finds exact duplicate files and lets you clean them safely.
apps.about: TwinClean scans your device for exact duplicate files across photos, videos, audio and documents, grouping every match so you can review before cleaning. Every match is verified with a full SHA-256 checksum over the whole file -- identical content is the only thing that matches, never "similar looking" -- and Smart Select keeps the newest, best copy by default. Every file can be opened directly from the app to double-check before cleaning, and each duplicate group shows the exact evidence used to match it (size, checksum, byte-for-byte comparison). Cleaning moves files to an in-app Trash (restorable for 30 days) with single-file, whole-group, or restore-everything options, never deletes originals outright. Sign in with Google (optional) to also find and clean exact duplicates in your own Google Drive, matched on Drive's checksum and moved to Drive's own Trash -- your account is never required for the core on-device feature. The app checks for new versions on launch and installs updates directly in-app.
